commitments.detail: Used oil drums will be transported to the local hazardous waste facility for proper disposal.
Expired medical cold packs will be returned to their original supplier for recycling or proper disposal.
Vehicle batteries will be picked up by the base maintenance shop for reconditioning or disposal.
Empty compressed-air cylinders will be picked up by the base supply warehouse for refilling or disposal.
Used oil drums will be transported to the local hazardous waste facility for proper disposal.
Expired medical cold packs will be returned to the vehicle maintenance shop for reuse.
Vehicle batteries and empty compressed-air cylinders will be picked up by the waste management contractor on the specified dates.
Used oil drums will be disposed of according to base procedures.
Expired medical cold packs will be returned for proper disposal.
Used oil drums will be disposed of by 2023-10-15.
Vehicle batteries require proper labeling before pickup.
Expired medical cold packs will be returned by 2023-10-18.
Empty compressed-air cylinders will be picked up by 2023-10-20.
